title: Sordland/Turn02/InT_RailwayContract
description: This conversation is available if the President has chosen to build the L-1 Highspeed Rail. The intracies of this project is that it avoids Erlory which is very negative for that city and its economic connectivity. It bolsters Gus Mangers position and his construction company ally Underhall to take contracts. The advantages are trickling rural development up to Holsord and through Anrica, Gelsord and other villages in between. The increase of the speed of travel for passengers and logistics alike. Symon Holl advises to take the ministry approved firms. There is a choice between giving the contract and then project responsibility to Symon or Gus.
